feasibility_reasoning:
Deciding lines:
- src/components/interests/JoinUsForm.tsx:861 renders TopicsDroplist only when `showInterests && allItems.length > 0`, and src/components/interests/TopicsDroplist.tsx:209 returns null for an empty list.
- src/components/interests/__tests__/topicsDroplist.test.tsx:259 pins that contract: an empty catalog renders neither the heading nor the button.
- So "enabled = droplist open" is circular: the trigger never renders without data. H3 has to add a pending-vs-empty state and render the heading and trigger while the catalog is not yet fetched. That changes the SSR markup. Parity still holds because both sides render it, and CLS gets better.
- Submit path, JoinUsForm.tsx:347/404-405/464: with no catalog loaded, the `requireInterests` check is bypassed, CRM interest fields are dropped and `my.save` is skipped. The handler must `await fetchQuery` before validating, which needs the inline queryFn (src/hooks/useInterests.ts:67-127) extracted into a query-options factory.
- Pre-picked interests (JoinUsForm.tsx:272-275, from user_follows or localStorage) need labels for the pills (TopicsDroplist.tsx:225), so `enabled` must also include `picked.size > 0` and the builder canvas.
- The chips SSR warm would have to touch two registries (src/lib/builder/prefetch.ts ~277 and ~507) and fits the ssr-budgets 6-subrequest cap. It is moot for prod `/`, where JoinUs uses the default droplist with requireInterests:"0".
- FooterSlideup gating (src/lib/ads/queries.ts:285 needs an options arg; src/components/ads/FooterSlideup.tsx:21) is feasible and matches the no-warm doctrine at src/routes/$.tsx:497-502. It changes the delay tests (footerSlideup.test.tsx:228-275) and needs business sign-off.
- No conflict with check:chunks, noHasSelectors or loader-policy.
blocking_issues: Trigger is gated on catalog data (JoinUsForm.tsx:861, TopicsDroplist.tsx:209, test topicsDroplist.test.tsx:259): enabled-on-open is circular without a new pending-vs-empty render state, plus loading and a11y text.

Submit regressions when the catalog is not loaded: requireInterests bypassed (JoinUsForm.tsx:347), CRM interests silently dropped (:404-405), my.save skipped (:464). Must await fetchQuery via an extracted interestCatalogQueryOptions factory.
enabled must also be true for picked.size>0 (user_follows or localStorage seed) and for the builder canvas, or the pills lose their labels.
Effect double-counted with H6: the 166-198 ms recalc is the device-switch commit, not the catalog re-render.
FooterSlideup interaction gating is a product change (bouncers never see the bar), needs sign-off, and footerSlideup.test.tsx delay tests must change.
effect_reasoning:
1. The claimed recalc belongs to H6, not H3.
- The 166-198 ms ULT (797 elements, 7401 ms PO time in runs/m4-ok-1) is the BuilderRenderer device switch; `data-device` flips at 7391 ms.
- The JoinUs input name/type writes at 7390.7 ms are no-ops (old == new) inside that same commit. In m4b-ok-2 everything lands at 8788.5 ms, the device flip at 8788 ms. In m4b-ok-1 and m4b-ok-3 the switch never commits, and there are zero JoinUs rewrites even though the catalog was fetched.
- The catalog-arrival commits (7139/7149/7208 ms) are each under 50 ms; there is no long task between 3504 and 7396 ms.
- H6 already books this same recalc.

2. FCP, LCP and SI: 0.
- Every H3 request starts after observed LCP: prod mobile 4531 vs 3303 ms, prod desktop 4232 vs 3722 ms, harness ≥753 vs ≤544 ms.
- So Lantern leaves them out of the FCP and LCP graphs. TTI is unscored and pinned by gtag.

3. Canonical harness: 0.
- The browser backend at 127.0.0.1:4199 is dead (status -1, three attempts each), and the fixture's categories, tags and ad_placements tables are empty (homeFixture.ts:43-56).
- So nothing re-renders and ΔTBT ≈ 0, against ±464 ms A/A noise. An HTML-transform what-if cannot model this and would be A=A, so I did not run one.

4. Prod LH mobile (M3 host): at most -38 ms.
- TBT 202 = gtag 153 + React 49 (88-50 = 38 at sim 6972 ms, plus 9 and 2).
- The catalog lands at 5.49 s right after the JoinUsForm chunk loads at 5.26 s, so the 88 ms task is the only candidate.
- Upper bound -38 ms ≈ +1.2 points near TBT 250 (log-normal 200/600: 0.846 → 0.888, × 30).
- Ad half ≈ 0: no creative or impression request in the window.
- Desktop TBT is 0, so 0 there.

5. PSI and overlap with H7.
- On PSI's slower host, roughly 2× longer tasks would give at most -80 to -140 ms. That holds only if H6 and H7 have not landed, and it cannot be verified offline.
- H7 islands remove JoinUs hydration, and with it the catalog fetch, from the LH window, so H3's incremental effect is about 0.
corrected_estimate: Network: -3 fetches and -3 preflights in prod (confirmed). TBT: 0 ms in the canonical harness; 0 to -40 ms on prod-like LH mobile, all from the catalog half, ad half about 0; desktop 0; about 0 incremental once H7 lands. Score: 0 to +1 point mobile, 0 desktop. Book the 166-198 ms recalc to H6 only.
